		1. 📖 Overview
	

🤗 MigrationBench
is a large-scale code migration benchmark dataset at the repository level,
across multiple programming languages.

Current and initial release includes java 8 repositories with the maven build system… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AmazonScience/migration-bench-java-full.
reputation: High-quality, repository-level migration benchmark released by AmazonScience, used in code-migration and program-repair research communities.
